eyebrow: Assigning a workspace to each stage
caption: Before anything can deploy, each of the three stages needs its own real workspace assigned to it.
Once assigned, the three stages show real content and refresh times — Development feeding Test feeding Production.

eyebrow: Comparing a stage against its source
caption: Before deploying, Test's items are compared against Development's — same, new, or only in the source.
Deploying from Test to UAT lists exactly what's different and what's new, with the option to continue even if one item fails.

subtitle: Zooming out from one pipeline to the whole tenant.
